instruction: Increase the mouse cursor size to make it easier to see.

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing the mouse cursor size setting. This is infeasible because detecting the current cursor size requires parsing X11 or Wayland cursor theme settings and comparing pixel dimensions, which varies across desktop environments and cannot be reliably validated.
